claims.text: Macaw currently has a command line interface and a Telegram bot as its primary interfaces.
The Telegram interface allows multi-modal interactions including text, speech, image, and click.
Macaw's interfaces support various devices and operating systems such as Android, iOS, Linux, Mac OS, and Windows.
